# Finality Market Intelligence

> Agent- and user-accessible market, AI, and Cardano on-chain intelligence — paid per result in ADA via x402.

## Platform
- Website: https://finality.accuracy.wtf
- API: https://finality-x402-backend.onrender.com
- Facilitator: https://facilitator.goplausible.xyz
- Network: Cardano Preprod (`cardano:preprod`) · Asset: lovelace (ADA)
- Protocol: x402 exact · Client: CIP-30 (Lace / Nami)
- Tags: finality, x402, cardano
